changes: A COMPRESSOR saved before the module was installed (on stock firmware) now comes up with its side-chain off: KEY OFF, KFLT and KGN centred, MON OFF. Stock firmware leaves 127/0/0/0 in the hidden page-2 slots, which 0.1.1 read as KEY "T127" with the key filter shut and the key gain at minimum, so the key barely reached the detector after KEY was turned down (Modwerk report #321).
A KEY already set to OFF or T1..T8 is never changed, so projects saved with 0.1.1 load as before. The check runs once per audio frame over the sixteen FX slots and never marks the Part as edited.

The ColdFire code grows by 204 bytes. 12 selections that 0.1.1 built now run out of effect-menu space, each holding Euclid with Scale Quantizer or eight or more modules; every selection of one or two other modules still builds.

Hardware: author-reported functional test on an MKI with two instances across both DSP cores, Part/project save and reload and a power cycle. Duration was not reported and no stress or maximum-load test was made.

USB package (14 Oct 2026; distribution only, the module source and version are unchanged): loads over USB on the Modwerk beta base, which carries Sidechain’s DSP engine resident and dormant and admits this exact package through a trust row built into it. The package calls the base’s write lease by address, so it needs that exact base; with an older base the site asks for a base update first. It answers Mute Modes’ ev_mute_keep for its key track. Host tests only: the emulator controllers scenario has not run, and there is no hardware run of this package. The owner waived hardware evidence for this exact version’s USB package for the beta.

Site sync on the beta base (beta test run 2, 14 Oct 2026; the package is unchanged): removing it while its controller runs no longer ends the sync with “The Octatrack refused this step.” The base answers the first removal busy while it stops the controller and drops the staged package; the site now stages it again, as it does for the base's other busy refusals. Checked on a development twin through the development link (Sidechain installed, running, removed in one command) and by the site's tests; the site's own path has not run on the unit yet.
Integrate Sidechain Compressor into the shared browser builder so it can compose with compatible modules.
Keep native COMPRESSOR key and monitoring controls. Recorded software/resource checks do not claim broad hardware qualification.
First Modwerk catalog release as standalone firmware, with COMPRESSOR key-source selection and sidechain monitoring controls.

USB package rebuilt for the fixed beta base (beta test run 1, 14 Oct 2026). On the unit its controller never started before, so the KEY page was missing: the base's owned DSP job channel closed at boot, and a stock delay on T3 or T7 FX2 kept it waiting. Both are fixed, and its page record now keeps stock's page-1 enables and no longer lands one byte high (a GCC 16.2 miscompile that crashed the unit when COMPRESSOR's SETUP opened). Its frame hook takes the write lease only when a COMPRESSOR needs resetting. Seen on a development twin of the fixed base: KEY, KFLT, KGN and MON on SETUP, and T4 ducked 27 dB keyed from T3 on the same core. Not yet tested: keying across cores, MON, Mute Modes keeping the key track, the tester image and a power cycle.
